external_entities.name: CDN
external_entities.description: The content delivery network from which readers fetch images, stylesheets and downloads.

processes.name: web server
processes.description: The web server runs the CMS and serves the public site.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database's classification is confidential because it contains accounts and comments in addition to site records.
assumptions.basis: The database is stated to contain accounts and comments, which are information about people or their activity.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN bucket's classification is public because it stores assets that readers fetch from the public CDN.
assumptions.basis: The bucket contains published assets that readers fetch from the CDN.
